title: Pls fix this!!
text: Pls fix this!!. Dries rice out in less than 24 hrs.  my last Zojirushi was absolutely fantastic. I bought it 15 years ago. It lasted about 13 years. I did not hesitate to buy another one. They missed the mark with the heating thing. I contacted customer service and they told me I need to push the extended warm button.  But we always forget because this wasn’t a thing with the last model.  The rice is very good fresh though. Just disappointing to waste so much rice.

product_metadata.title: Zojirushi Micom 10 Cup Stainless Steel Rice Cooker and Warmer
features: Nonstick coating in the inner pot for the easy release of food and quick cleaning
Retractable cord for a simple storage solution
Makes 1 to 10 cups of rice and keeps it warm, fresh, and moist for hours
description: Create a chef inspired meal with this Zojirushi Micom rice cooker and warmer. Featuring a stainless steel construction for long lasting durability, it has a nonstick coating on the inner pot for the easy release of food and quick cleaning. With two delayed time settings and an interchangeable melody and beep signal, it also features a retractable cord for a simple storage solution. It makes one to 10 cups of rice, and keeps it warm for hours. This rice cooker and warmer includes a rice spatula, a removable spatula holder, and a measuring cup. With micro computerized fuzzy logic technology and a single control operation, it has a cool touch exterior and is the perfect addition to any kitchen.
11" L x 10" W x 15" H, with a 10 cup capacity
